explanation: Max von Sydow played the knight. The chess game with Death has been parodied many times, including in Bill & Ted's Bogus Journey (1991).

claims.text: Ingmar Bergman wrote and directed The Seventh Seal (1957).
Carl Theodor Dreyer, Lars von Trier and Lasse Hallström did not direct The Seventh Seal.
Max von Sydow played the knight in The Seventh Seal.
Bill & Ted's Bogus Journey (1991) parodies the film's game with Death.
